result.title: RootDown: Deploying and Benchmarking Models for Beet-Root Detection on Edge Devices
result.comment: Accepted at MLCSA Workshop at Asian Conference on Computer Vision (ACCV 2026). Benchmark, code and models available at https://github.com/semanticsugarbeets/rootdown
result.summary: Quality inspection of sugar beets after harvest and storage is critical to preserve sugar content and ensure optimal processing efficiency. The transfer of harvested beets to field clamps or trucks provides an opportunity to visually inspect individual beets automatically on loader conveyors. However, this is a challenging task as the large number of beets causes partial overlap and occlusion, complicating both annotation and detection. In this work, we propose an end-to-end image-based pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets in loading scenarios as a first step toward automated quality inspection. We introduce a dedicated benchmark and present an automatic annotation strategy that leverages the SAM 3 foundation model to generate bounding boxes. We compare models trained on manually annotated and automatically generated labels. Additionally, we investigate deployment considerations by benchmarking multiple inference configurations, including execution on an edge device, under realistic operational constraints regarding precision, inference time and power consumption. Our results show that, despite substantial occlusion and inherent annotation ambiguity, foundation-model-based labels can substitute for a substantial share of manual annotation, trading labeling effort for data volume at a modest accuracy cost. Furthermore, we demonstrate that a Raspberry Pi 5 equipped with a Hailo accelerator enables high-performance, low-power inference, making it a practical solution for mobile outdoor deployment.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向收获后甜菜质量检测，提出端到端图像检测流程，构建部分遮挡甜菜的基准，利用 SAM 3 自动生成标注框并与人工标注对比，同时在边缘设备上评测推理精度、时延与功耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于农业场景下的目标检测与边缘部署基准，不涉及视觉推理状态、证据获取或停止决策，自动标注仅是数据生产效率问题，缺少可供 LVR 借鉴的具体线索。
